nodes.title: Inventory mandatory and optional sovereignty dependencies

claims.statement: v15 generates a machine-readable dependency ledger that separates mandatory local runtime dependencies from optional remote provider and registry adapters.

acceptance: Mandatory external runtime dependencies are identified separately from optional remote adapters.
Unknown dependency evidence remains visible.

nodes.title: Prove a zero-key local sovereign workflow

claims.statement: The zero-key local workflow selects a local model profile, filters governed memory, executes a local tool, creates an artifact, produces an independent attestation, encrypts a local backup, and restores it without a commercial key or network attempt.

acceptance: No commercial key is used.
No network attempt is recorded.
Artifact, attestation, backup, and restore hashes match.

nodes.title: Implement portable governed memory and context-separated key hierarchy

claims.statement: Portable memory bundles preserve scope, provenance, confidence, authority, correction, sensitivity, expiry, and integrity while rejecting cross-tenant import and conflicting records.
v15 derives context-separated installation, tenant, workspace, data, backup, and signing key material and uses separate Ed25519 identities for portable signatures.

acceptance: Cross-tenant import fails closed.
Duplicate and conflict states are distinct.
Wrong context produces a different key.

nodes.title: Implement signed air-gap agent handoff and return bundles

claims.statement: A signed air-gap task can be exported, verified on a disconnected node, executed within capability ceilings, returned with a separate signature, and imported only when task hash, tenant, workspace, receiver, and capabilities remain bound.

acceptance: Tampering, expiry, cross-tenant scope, wrong receiver, and capability escalation fail closed.
Valid result preserves exact task binding.

nodes.title: Implement signed offline updates with dry-run and rollback

claims.statement: The signed offline update prototype verifies compatibility, hashes, paths, and version direction; applies changed files; validates the result; and restores the previous installation after explicit rollback or injected failure.

acceptance: Dry-run identifies blockers.
Injected failure restores the previous version and content.
Downgrades and invalid signatures are rejected.

nodes.title: Implement sovereignty control plane and hardware-aware placement

claims.statement: Hardware feasibility, tenant trust, data locality, node health, load, and energy are evaluated before utility scoring in sovereign work placement.
The sovereignty control plane displays separate sovereignty dimensions, fatal dependencies, network evidence, key separation, vertical-slice evidence, and blockers; unknown evidence remains blocking.

acceptance: Infeasible models and unauthorized nodes cannot win.
Unknown evidence remains blocking.
The UI does not collapse fatal weaknesses into a decorative score.

nodes.title: Run a full process-level outbound network audit

claims.statement: The v15 application-level network guard proves that declared sovereign adapters deny remote requests in air-gap mode, but a complete process-level outbound traffic audit and offline clean installation have not run.

acceptance: Unexpected outbound attempts are zero.
All allowed local endpoints are declared and evidenced.
evidenceRequired: Disposable environment packet or socket audit

nodes.title: Benchmark real local model artifacts on target hardware

claims.statement: Local model and energy profiles in v15 include feasibility and estimate contracts, but no real generative model artifact or target-hardware energy benchmark was executed.

acceptance: A real local model meets declared quality and resource floors.
Artifact, license, source, and hardware evidence are complete.

nodes.title: Measure energy and thermal behavior on the target sovereign node

claims.statement: Local model and energy profiles in v15 include feasibility and estimate contracts, but no real generative model artifact or target-hardware energy benchmark was executed.

acceptance: Estimates are replaced or bounded by measured confidence intervals.
Energy decisions cannot trigger without sufficient confidence.
evidenceRequired: Target mini-PC or GPU node measurement report

nodes.title: Create an offline dependency and model installation bundle

claims.statement: The v15 application-level network guard proves that declared sovereign adapters deny remote requests in air-gap mode, but a complete process-level outbound traffic audit and offline clean installation have not run.

acceptance: Install succeeds with registry and model hub unavailable.
Every artifact has source, hash, license, and compatibility metadata.

nodes.title: Reject replayed or revoked air-gap bundles

claims.statement: Air-gap task and result acceptance now requires a purpose-scoped, tenant-scoped, workspace-scoped, non-revoked local trust key and consumes a durable replay identifier that survives process restart.

acceptance: A replayed task or result is rejected after constructing a new ledger instance.
A revoked or wrong-scope key is rejected before payload acceptance.
evidenceRequired: Signed handoff proof with durable replay rejection
